purpose: First verified black-and-white visual aid set for learner-facing Physics questions.
selectionRule: Only self-contained, answer-aligned questions with a useful explanatory visual were linked. Questions that refer to an unavailable original figure were not reconstructed.
visualVerification: The portable SVG line art was visually checked after upload. Embedded SVG text was removed because the renderer substituted missing glyph boxes; the original question stems retain the necessary values and labels.
